note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; the new species is described from a single soldier (the holotype), with the antennae incomplete. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 23 of the original, in millimetres. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The arrangement of setae and short hairs on the head separates this species from all others of the genus: the sides of the head, the antennal region and the underside are covered with short hairs and a few longer setae, whereas the vertex behind the frontal tube and the posterior part are entirely without hairs or setae; the pronotum has many setae but no contrasting short hairs.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum pale yellow. Sides of the head, antennal region and underside covered with short hairs and a few longer setae; vertex behind the frontal tube and posterior part without hairs or setae; pronotum with many setae but no contrasting short hairs; posterior half of the tergites with setae. Sides of the head slightly curved and narrowed anteriorly. Frontal tube of moderate size, projecting beyond the base of the postclypeus from above. Narrowest part of the postmentum slightly wider than 3/5 of the greatest width (15:23). Antennae (specimen incomplete): segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to or slightly shorter than segment 3 and slightly longer than segment 2. Sides of the labrum curved, the white median lobe giving a trilobed appearance. Apex of the left mandible rather long, with many distinct serrations in front of the notch and coarser serrations behind it. Margin of the right mandible in front of the notch almost evenly curved (not S-shaped), the notch angle slightly less than a right angle, with one rather sharp projecting tooth. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 23, single holotype): head length including mandibles (estimated) 4.23; head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.82; head length to the lateral mandibular bases 3.03; head width 2.33; head thickness 1.67; frontal tube length 0.38; labrum width 0.80; left mandible length 1.59; right mandible length from the notch 0.89; pronotum length 0.78; pronotum width 1.23; hind tibia length 2.15.
